localBiteReport: The most recent available report covering this area is from the week of September 18–24, 2026 (about one week old). Capt. Adam Schroeder of Ignite The Bite Charters in Destin called the inshore bite one of the best he had seen all year, with bait now easy to find early in the morning and redfish, flounder, and trout all responding well around the Destin-area bridges and structure. Both slot-sized reds and bull redfish are biting, with an outgoing tide around the bridges being a favored setup; live croakers and spot minnows are the go-to baits for larger fish. The week prior (Sept 4–10), Capt. Blake Nelson with Last Cast Charters reported that bait schools were pushing from open water into bayous, flats, and bridge areas throughout Choctawhatchee Bay, setting up improving redfish and general flats action expected to build toward October. Water temperature at this location today is 85°F.
